 v isFloat ifTrue: [ Dictionary newFrom: { 'type' -> 'float'. 'value' -> (v asIEEE64BitWord printPaddedWith: $0 to: 16 base: 16) asLowercase } ] ifFalse: [

 [ next class = MAChainAccessor ] whileTrue: [ steps add: (exportAccessor value: next accessor). next := next next ].

exportNode := [ :id :d | | n props labels |
 props := Dictionary new.
 d properties keysAndValuesDo: [ :k :v |
 (#(conditions labels) includes: k) ifFalse: [
 k = #displayBlockOrSymbol ifTrue: [ v = #greaseString ifFalse: [ self error: 'Unsupported display override' ] ] ifFalse: [ props at: k asString put: (encode value: v) ] ] ].

d class = MANumberDescription ifTrue: [ selectors addAll: #(descriptionMin descriptionMax) ].
d class = MABooleanDescription ifTrue: [ selectors addAll: #(descriptionTrueString descriptionFalseString) ].
d class = MAMemoDescription ifTrue: [ selectors add: #descriptionLineCount ].
d class = MATokenDescription ifTrue: [ selectors add: #descriptionSeparators ].
(d isKindOf: MAOptionDescription) ifTrue: [ selectors addAll: #(descriptionSorted descriptionExtensible) ].
(d isKindOf: MAToManyRelationDescription) ifTrue: [ selectors addAll: #(descriptionOrdered descriptionDefinitive descriptionSorted) ].
d class = MAMultipleOptionDescription ifTrue: [ selectors addAll: #(descriptionDistinct descriptionOrdered) ].
selectors add: #descriptionName.
d isContainer ifTrue: [ selectors add: #descriptionChildren ].
(d isKindOf: MAReferenceDescription) ifTrue: [ selectors add: #descriptionReference ].
(d isKindOf: MAOptionDescription) ifTrue: [ selectors add: #descriptionOptions ].
liveDefault := d defaultLabel. liveCollectionKind := nil.
fields := OrderedCollection new.
selectors do: [ :selector | | item id ref refId |
 item := d perform: selector.
 item ifNotNil: [
 id := prefix , '.' , item accessor readSelector asString.
 selector = #descriptionLabel ifTrue: [ item default: (d accessor name ifNil: [ '' ] ifNotNil: [ :n | n asString ]) ].
 (#(descriptionChildren descriptionReference) includes: selector) ifTrue: [ item classes: (item classes select: [ :cls | concrete includes: cls name asString ]) ].
 selector = #descriptionChildren ifTrue: [ liveCollectionKind := item default class name asString. item default: OrderedCollection new ].
 fields add: item. root add: item. descs at: id put: item. ids at: item put: id. targetIds at: item put: id.
 (item isKindOf: MAReferenceDescription) ifTrue: [ ref := item reference. ref accessor: (MANullAccessor uuid: nil). refId := id , '.reference'. descs at: refId put: ref. ids at: ref put: refId. targetIds at: ref put: refId ] ] ].
reads := fields collect: [ :item | Dictionary newFrom: { 'field' -> (ids at: item). 'value' -> (encode value: (d readUsing: item)) } ].

allDescs addAll: descs.
Dictionary newFrom: { 'class' -> d class name asString. 'graph' -> graph. 'reads' -> reads asArray. 'liveLabelDefault' -> liveDefault. 'liveChildrenDefaultClass' -> liveCollectionKind. 'root' -> root }
].

(concrete reject: [ :className | className = 'MAClassDescription' ]) do: [ :className | | result | target := makeTarget value: className. result := build value: target value: 'recursive.1.target'. result removeKey: 'root'. records add: result ].
allDescs := Dictionary new. targetIds := IdentityDictionary new. objectIds := targetIds.
target := makeTarget value: 'MANumberDescription'.
level1 := build value: target value: 'recursive.1.target'.
level2 := build value: (level1 at: 'root') value: 'recursive.2.recursive.1.target'.
minField := (level1 at: 'root') detect: [ :d | d accessor name = #min ].
level3 := build value: minField value: 'recursive.3.recursive.1.target.min'.

editor := MACheckedMemento model: minField description: (level3 at: 'root'). editor write: 7 using: property. editor validate; commit.
editor := MACheckedMemento model: target description: (level1 at: 'root').
before := [ editor validate. #() ] on: MAValidationError do: [ :e | flatten value: e ].
editor write: 8 using: minField. editor validate; commit.

{ level1. level2. level3 } do: [ :level | level removeKey: 'root' ].
